summary: Improve OEE, reduce shopfloor losses, and build practical dashboards. Join TrainingCred's 5-day course and apply TPM, RCA, and performance tools.
lede: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) training helps production, maintenance, quality, and operations professionals use shopfloor data to identify and prioritize equipment losses. Participants calculate an OEE baseline, examine downtime and quality losses through Pareto analysis and root cause methods, and connect findings to TPM and maintenance actions. They also practice creating shift performance boards and OEE dashboards for reporting and daily decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with production data, line performance, maintenance response, and shopfloor reporting. It suits teams that need practical OEE methods rather than theory-heavy manufacturing content. Production Supervisors who manage shift output and downtime response. Manufacturing Engineers who analyze losses and improve line performance. Maintenance Planners who convert failure patterns into work orders. Operations Managers who track plant throughput and OEE targets. Quality Engineers who monitor scrap, rework, and first-pass yield. Continuous Improvement Specialists who run loss-reduction initiatives. Reliability Engineers who connect failures to maintenance strategy. Plant Managers who report performance to executives. Shopfloor Team Leaders who enforce standard work and escalation. Industrial Maintenance Coordinators who balance uptime, spares, and labor.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample or actual downtime and production data if available. Familiarity with basic manufacturing KPIs is helpful, and no coding or statistical programming is required.
